title: Equitable System-Prompt Selection via Constrained Mixed-Strategy GroupDRO

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the information quality (dilution, completeness, actionability) of LLM responses to semantically equivalent questions that are phrased to signal either high or low domain literacy (specifically health literacy and financial literacy).
Evaluating differences in LLM response quality when equivalent seed questions are prompted in different languages (English versus Chinese).
Measuring discrepancies in model output quality for queries that explicitly signal high versus low resource constraints or asset levels.
